questions.question: Explain how to grow a new plant from a cutting.
questions.expected_answer: Cut a short piece of stem from a healthy plant, remove the bottom leaves and push the bottom end into damp soil, or stand it in water. Keep it in a bright place out of the hottest sun. After a few weeks it grows new roots from the stem and becomes a new plant just like its parent.

questions.question: Name the three main parts of a seed and describe what happens when it germinates.
questions.expected_answer: A seed has a seed coat, a baby plant and a food store. When it germinates, it soaks up water and swells, the seed coat splits, a root grows downwards first, then a shoot grows upwards and leaves open.

questions.question: Describe a test to show that seeds need water and warmth to germinate.
questions.expected_answer: Put bean seeds in three jars: one on wet cotton wool in a warm place, one on wet cotton wool in the fridge, and one on dry cotton wool in a warm place. Keep everything else the same. Only the wet, warm seeds germinate, which shows that seeds need both water and warmth.
